answer: Getting caught costs the farm a 50% cut on 33891 POA of stakes, and the panel catches farms most of the time. Three words, three keepers: the jetty belongs to the toy shop, the trellis to the paint pot, the copper to the nursery — and the farm has visited none of them. No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. Printers turn out keys by the thousand; they cannot turn out each charcoal black is a season of logged firings plus a signed tilehouse record, and that is why Tile painter charcoal black warrant glazed at the clay pit guards the door.
